pretrained_model.label: Pretrained DPA4-Neo
pretrained_model.policy: One original model evaluated unchanged against all three DFT labels. No fitting, bias adjustment, energy alignment or checkpoint selection on Test50.
pretrained_model.pretraining_overlap: Unknown; independence from foundation pretraining is not established.

uncertainty: 2000 paired structure-bootstrap resamples; descriptive 95% percentile intervals, conditional on current subset. Unknown trajectory correlations and optional stopping are not covered.
energy_definition: Raw VASP TOTEN versus raw model energy, no fitted offset; meV/atom errors.
force_definition: All Cartesian components pooled; bootstrap samples whole structures. Equal-structure metrics and Al/Ti are also reported.
pretrained_comparison: The same unchanged pretrained predictions are compared with each functional on the same common geometries. Raw energy errors include energy-reference and functional differences; no offsets fitted. Pretraining overlap is unknown.

reasons: Fewer than 30 common structures (screening threshold, not a statistical guarantee).
PBE energy_meV_atom: RMSE bootstrap interval too wide for screening.

readiness.qualification: Heuristic discussion trigger based on fine-tuned models only. The pretrained baseline does not change the stopping rule. Report adaptive stopping, completion-order bias, coverage and uncertainty. Full fixed Test50 remains preferred.
